info.title: reamaze (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Simulated reamaze API for benchmarking. Derived from public documentation; no live service is called.

get.summary: Retrieve all Re:amaze conversations, tickets, and threads. Fetch the full list of support conversations.
get.description: Retrieve all Re:amaze conversations, tickets, and threads. Fetch the full list of support conversations.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Narrow conversations by their current state.

parameters.name: for
parameters.description: Restrict results to a specific user's email address.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Ordering applied to the returned results.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Restrict results to conversations with a given tag.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Restrict results to a specific category slug.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Which page of results to return.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Return only conversations created on or after this date.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Return only conversations created on or before this date.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Restrict results to a particular conversation channel or origin.

200.description: {conversations: [ConversationObject], page_size: int, page_count: int, total_count: int}
